definitions.explanation: Describes a person or animal that naturally warms up to people and is easy to get along with. Implies an endearing, open quality.

examples.japanese: {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧だ。

examples.english: That dog is so friendly that it wags its tail at everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人懐|ひとなつ}っこい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧とも⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: She has such a sociable personality that she quickly becomes friends with people she meets for the first time.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (person) + ⟦{懐|なつ}く→懐く：17463_natsuku⟧ (to become attached to) + っこい (adjective suffix indicating tendency). Literally describes someone who tends to warm up to people.

USAGE:
Always positive. Used for both people and animals, especially pets. Common collocations include {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧ (a warm smile) and {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a friendly personality).
